data.text:
Jacob Thomas vs The Food Safety Officer Kanjirapally ... on 9
April, 2024 
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas Crl.MC No.193/2023 1/1  IN THE HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM  PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE BECHU KURIAN THOMAS  Tuesday, the 9th day of April 2024 / 20th Chaihtra, 1946  CRL.M.APPL.NO.1/2023 IN CRL.MC NO. 193 OF 2023  ST 278/2021 OF JUDICIAL FIRST CLASS MAGISTRATE COURT - I, KANJIRAPPALLY  APPLICANTS/PETITIONERS/ACCUSED NOS 3 & 4:
 1. JACOB THOMAS, PLANTHARAYIL, VAZARMANGALAM POST, CHENGANNUR,
 ALAPPUZHA 689121(NOMINEE OF INTERGROW FOODS & BEVERAGES PVT LTD WHO  MARKETED THE UNSAFE CHILLI POWDER), PIN - 689121.
 AND ANOTHER  RESPONDENTS/COMPLAINANT,STATE & ANOTHER:
 1. THE FOOD SAFETY OFFICER KANJIRAPALLY CIRCLE 3RD FLOOR MINI CIVIL  STATION KANJIRAPALLY 686555.
 AND 2 OTHERS. 
 Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the  High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in S.T.278/2021  pending on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I,
 Kanjirapally, pending disposal of the above Criminal Miscellaneous Case.
 This application coming on for orders upon perusing the application  and this Court's order dated 11/10/2023 in Crl.M.A.No.1/2023 and upon  hearing the arguments of Sri.PREMJIT NAGENDRAN Advocates for the  petitioners and of PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the first and second respondents  and of Sri.SANTHAN V. NAIR, Advocate for the third respondent, the Court  passed the following:
 ORDER Interim order shall stand extended by three months.
